newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia Yield Spreads-Underperform in slow trade.
newsitem.headline: Australia Yield Spreads-Underperform in slow trade.

text.p: Australian bonds underperformed against the U.S. and Canada during a fairly sluggish trading session, giving up some of the spread tightening seen over the course of last week.
Traders blamed the local inaction on Friday's U.S. Independence Day holiday, and as the market awaited Thursday's key local labour force data for June.

The long end of the local market put in a strong performance last week, partly helped by firm U.S. Treasuries and on offshore demand in the wake of Moody's positive outlook on Australia's credit ratings.
However, spreads tightened to New Zealand, which came under pressure as the N.Z. TWI fell sharply.
